title: The Vault
tagline: Seven relics. Three are hidden. The keep will not tell you where.
description: A first-person exploration game set in a torch-lit fortress at last light. Seven relics are scattered through the keep: four sit in plain sight, three are hidden behind things the world shows you but never explains. A sconce burns blue instead of orange. A scorch mark surrounds the well. A banner hangs on a wall with no window behind it. Nothing tells you what any of it means. Players who look are rewarded with the vault beneath the courtyard; players who do not still finish with four of seven and a shorter story.

controls.action: Interact — light a sconce, climb out of the well

objectives.name: Recover the four open relics
objectives.brief: The hall, the east tower, the west breach.

secrets.name: Ever-Lamp
secrets.inWorldTell: One sconce on the north wall burns blue instead of orange, and it is dimmer than every other flame in the keep.
hints: One light in this keep is the wrong colour.
The north wall has a blue sconce. Blue means cold, or unlit, or something else.
Stand at the blue sconce on the north wall and press E. The wall beside it stops being a wall.

solution.note: Cross the courtyard to the north wall
Walk through where the wall was

secrets.name: Vault Key
secrets.inWorldTell: A wide scorch mark surrounds the well, burnt into the flagstones. Nothing else in the courtyard is burnt.
hints: Something burned here, and nobody cleaned it up.
The scorch mark around the well is not decoration.
Walk into the well. You fall to the chamber below and the key is on the floor.

solution.note: Head for the well, south-east of the hall

secrets.name: Ashen Crown
secrets.inWorldTell: Inside the great hall, a banner hangs on the north-east wall — the only wall with cloth and no window behind it.
hints: A banner needs a reason to hang where it hangs.
Inside the hall, one wall has cloth but nothing behind it.
The banner on the north-east wall of the hall. Get up to it.

solution.note: Enter the hall through the south doorway

secrets.name: Vault Seal
secrets.inWorldTell: The chamber below the courtyard is lit and empty until you carry the key.
hints: The vault does not open for nothing.
You need what is beneath the well first.
Carry the Vault Key into the chamber below the courtyard.

walkthrough.note: North through the gatehouse into the courtyard
Into the great hall — the Steward's Cup is on the table
Jump to the banner for the Ashen Crown
West breach for the Broken Blade
Open the false wall for the Ever-Lamp
